newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds higher, but quiet.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds higher, but quiet.

text.p: High protein soymeal prices were higher on the UK meals and feeds market on Thursday following gains in Chicago.
However, business was quiet ahead of a trade dinner in London on Thursday evening.
"People seem to have been heading to London a lot earlier this year, which I suppose sums the market up," said one broker.
High pro soymeal was offered two to three stg up ex-mill while store were 2.50 stg down to one stg up.
Sunflower and rapemeal prices were unchanged while corn gluten feed pellets were one stg up.
One trade for high protein soymeal was reported on the east coast when 215 stg was paid for spot ex-store.
